title: Build a URL from a name
summary: Laravel: Build a URL from a name. Change the route path and observe the generated link.
introduction: name gives a route a reusable label. GET /link builds a relative URL to that named route.
learningObjectives: Build a URL from a name with Laravel
Change the route path and observe the generated link

blocks.text: Create a practice Laravel project with Composer, then replace routes/web.php with one example. Start php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000. These read-only starter routes need no database.
Build a URL from a name

blocks.title: Build a URL from a name
blocks.code:
<?php
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
Route::get("/hello/{name}", fn (string $name) => $name)->name("hello");
Route::get("/link", fn () => route("hello", ["name" => "Asha"], false));

blocks.text: The named route stores its path pattern. route fills in Asha and returns a relative path.
Change the route path and observe the generated link.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The route input key must match the placeholder name.
